items.name: member-picker
items.title: Member picker
items.description: Pick a member of your org: a members-only GET /api/members route, backed by list_org_members, and a searchable list to choose from.
items.docs: Add the route to `api` in server/app.ts: import { orgMembersRoute } from "./org-members.ts", then "GET /api/members": orgMembersRoute(botpage). In the UI: const members = useOrgMembers() (from @/lib/org-members), then <MemberPicker members={members} value={userId} onChange={setUserId} />.
